news.title: Gas Safety & Energy-Saving Cooking Tips
news.subtitle: Equip yourself with gas safety knowledge, glass care techniques, and blue flame adjustment tips for total peace of mind.
news.safety_box_title: Safety Alert: 4 Urgent Rules When Suspecting a Gas Leak
news.rule1_desc: Tiny electric sparks inside switches can ignite accumulated gas vapor.
news.rule2_title: DO NOT use lighters or matches
news.rule2_desc: Never test leaks with an open flame (use soap bubble solution instead).
news.rule3_desc: Turn the cylinder knob clockwise tightly to prevent further gas escape.
news.rule4_desc: Facilitate natural ventilation to disperse gas; gently fan gas outward with a manual hand fan.
